original_defects: Changing a budget currency relabelled existing request amounts without conversion, including approved/spent amounts
Moving a pending request to a differently denominated budget silently changed the meaning of its amount
policy: A budget with any linked request, including pending/rejected/archived, retains its currency. Pending request moves require matching source/destination currencies. Empty budget currency and same-currency limit/name edits remain allowed. No automatic conversion or retroactive correction.

coverage: all five linked request states reject currency relabelling unchanged
cross-currency pending move rejects; same-currency move and amount correction allowed
independent approval and existing budget ceiling remain tested
empty budget currency change and same-currency limit edits allowed
file restart preserves data/revision/audit; validated empty-database restore retains totals and protection

browser.initial_records: authenticated API; employee request approved by different admin

limits: No currency conversion, exchange rates, bank transfer or real payment
Existing previously mislabelled data is not automatically repaired; manual reconciliation required
Server tested locally; no new hosting, customer acceptance or external security audit
Domain validation and error messages only; UI layout and database schema unchanged
